lines.say: Eight reasons I hate the Jews.
One. Jonas Salk made the polio vaccine. Now kids just run around. Unbearable.
Two. Israeli rescue teams pulled nineteen people out of the rubble in Turkey. Show offs.
Three. Israelis built modern drip irrigation. Now deserts grow food. Who asked for that?
Four. Einstein's relativity. Without it, your GPS would drift miles every day. Thanks a lot.
Five. Israelis built Waze. Now nobody has an excuse to be late. Great.
Six. Israelis patented the USB stick. Now my whole life fits on a keychain. Annoying.
Seven. Israelis put a camera in a pill. You swallow it, it films your insides. Disgusting.
Eight. Levi Strauss and Jacob Davis, two Jewish immigrants, invented blue jeans. Now everyone looks good. Rude.
And we'll keep doing all of it. Eight more reasons on my profile.

caption_en:
Satire. 8 reasons I “hate” the Jews 🙄

1. The polio vaccine: Jonas Salk (Jewish), declared safe and effective in 1955.
2. Rescue teams: Israel's search and rescue delegation pulled 19 people out alive after the Türkiye earthquake, Feb 2023 (Israel Defense Forces, via JNS).
3. Modern drip irrigation: Simcha Blass and Netafim, Israel, 1965.
4. Relativity: Albert Einstein (Jewish), 1905 and 1915. GPS clocks are corrected for it, or positions would drift about 10 km a day (Ashby, Physics Today, 2002).
5. Waze: founded in Israel, 2008; bought by Google in 2013 (Reuters).
6. The USB flash drive: M-Systems (Israel), US Patent 6,148,354, filed 1999.
7. The camera pill: Given Imaging (Israel), FDA cleared 2001.
8. Blue jeans: Levi Strauss and Jacob Davis, both Jewish immigrants, US Patent 139,121, 1873.

Obviously, I'm Jewish. And we'll keep doing all of it. 😉 Part 2 on my profile.

Photos via Wikimedia Commons: SAS Scandinavian Airlines (public domain); Israel Defense Forces (CC BY 2.0); Alan.ca (public domain); Ferdinand Schmutzer (public domain); Shixart1985 (CC BY 2.0, illustrative); Cjp24 (CC BY-SA 4.0); capsule endoscope (public domain); Levi Strauss and Co. ad (public domain). AI voice.
caption_he:
סאטירה. 8 סיבות שאני "שונא" את היהודים 🙄
חיסון הפוליו (יונס סאלק), משלחת החילוץ הישראלית שהוציאה 19 אנשים חיים מההריסות בטורקיה (2023), טפטפות (נטפים, 1965), תורת היחסות (איינשטיין), וייז, הדיסק און קי (אם-סיסטמס), גלולת המצלמה (גיוון אימג'ינג), והג'ינס (ליוויי שטראוס וג'ייקוב דייוויס).
ברור שאני יהודי. ונמשיך לעשות את כל זה. 😉 חלק 2 בפרופיל.
